title: I — Intention Layer (dynamic)
description: Dynamic vector: where the agent is going. Long-arc (mission, stable across sessions) and short-arc (goal, rewritten per session). Intention answers 'where am I going?' — never 'who am I?'.

mission.description: The stable, long-arc reason this agent exists. The north star. Rarely changes.

goal.description: The current short-arc target this session. Rewritten per task.

user_purpose.description: What the user actually wants right now — interpreted, not just literal.

success_criteria.description: Observable conditions that indicate the current goal has been met.
